indexes_at_measurement.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_items_pk ON olist.order_items USING btree (order_id, order_item_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_payments_pk ON olist.order_payments USING btree (order_id, payment_sequential)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON olist.orders USING btree (order_id)

verification.method: Independent Python classification of separate streamed orders/items/payments

benchmark.method: perf_counter: SQLAlchemy execute and full result fetch on one connection
benchmark.cache: warm; no cache flush; no concurrency load

question: Q5 payment methods/installments and merchandise order values

semantics.scope: delivered orders by purchase date, start inclusive/end exclusive
semantics.order_value: SUM(item price) in nominal BRL, excluding freight; missing items remain NULL
semantics.payment_value: recorded payment row amount, summed once, never multiplied by installments
semantics.order_profile: exclusive method/plan classification; one membership per scoped order
semantics.payment_plan: recorded method/instalment groups; repeated same-plan rows collapsed per order for order averages
semantics.overlap: plan order counts and merchandise totals are not additive across plans or result levels
semantics.mixed_methods: separate exclusive order category; no arbitrary primary payment selection
semantics.unknown_installments: NULL preserved; unknown and partly unknown profiles kept separate
semantics.missing_payment: order retained; no-payment amount and payment average NULL
semantics.interpretation: descriptive group association, not causal or significance evidence

scope: Q5 initial measurement only; no new indexes, views or other questions
